name: Kemono no Juusha to Ouji no Hanayome
original_name: ケモノの従者と王子の花嫁
source:
"Welcome back, Princess"

One day, suddenly, three therianthropes appeared before the heroine?!

A petite and elegant cat. 

An especially observant eagle.

An iguana, who wears an aloof smile.

They have a shocking announcement for the already bewildered heroine.

"You have been chosen as the candidate for a bride-to-be. Would you do us the pleasure of becoming our masters' bride?"

The three valets have come from their countries in search of a bride for their masters.

"This could become a great article..."

Our SF-occult magazine writer/camera operator heroine agrees to share her house with the three men, hoping for the scoop of her life.

Right now it's just a few odd housemates, but what will become of her future?

[Translated from the [url=https://konpeido.jp/kemohana/menu_story.php]official website[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎回来，公主。”

某天，三名兽人突然出现在女主角面前？！

娇小优雅的猫兽人。

观察力格外敏锐的鹰兽人。

总挂着冷淡微笑的鬣蜥兽人。

他们向本就不知所措的女主角宣布了一件惊人的事。

“您已获选成为未来新娘的人选。能否请您成为我们主人的新娘？”

这三名侍从分别来自不同国家，正在为各自的主人寻找新娘。

“这说不定能写成一篇大新闻……”

女主角是一名撰写科幻与神秘学杂志的记者兼摄影师。为了得到人生中最大的独家新闻，她同意和这三名男子同住。

目前他们只是几位古怪的室友，但她的未来会变成什么样？

[译自[url=https://konpeido.jp/kemohana/menu_story.php]官方网站[/url]]
